_comment: Captured from Biomni's env_desc by scripts/vendor-manifest.py. Data, not code — it lets the data lake and software catalogs work without a Biomni install. A live Biomni always takes precedence.
license: MIT (Biomni, snap-stanford). Individual datasets carry their own terms.

datasets.BindingDB_All_202409.tsv: Measured binding affinities between proteins and small molecules for drug discovery.
datasets.DepMap_CRISPRGeneDependency.csv: Gene dependency probability estimates for cancer cell lines, including all DepMap models.
datasets.DepMap_CRISPRGeneEffect.csv: Genome-wide CRISPR gene effect estimates for cancer cell lines, including all DepMap models.
datasets.DepMap_Model.csv: Metadata describing all cancer models/cell lines which are referenced by a dataset contained within the DepMap portal.
datasets.DepMap_OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenes: Gene expression in TPMs for cancer cell lines, including all DepMap models.
datasets.McPAS-TCR.parquet: T-cell receptor sequences and specificity data from McPAS database.
datasets.affinity_capture-ms.parquet: Protein-protein interactions detected via affinity capture and mass spectrometry.
datasets.affinity_capture-rna.parquet: Protein-RNA interactions detected by affinity capture.
datasets.broad_repurposing_hub_molecule_with_smil: Molecules from Broad Institute's Drug Repurposing Hub with SMILES annotations.
datasets.broad_repurposing_hub_phase_moa_target_i: Drug phases, mechanisms of action, and target information from Broad Institute.
datasets.czi_census_datasets_v4.parquet: Datasets from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative's Cell Census.
datasets.ddinter_alimentary_tract_metabolism.csv: Drug-drug interactions for alimentary tract and metabolism drugs from DDInter 2.0 database.
datasets.ddinter_antineoplastic.csv: Drug-drug interactions for antineoplastic and immunomodulating agents from DDInter 2.0 database.
datasets.ddinter_antiparasitic.csv: Drug-drug interactions for antiparasitic products from DDInter 2.0 database.
datasets.ddinter_blood_organs.csv: Drug-drug interactions for blood and blood forming organs drugs from DDInter 2.0 database.
datasets.ddinter_dermatological.csv: Drug-drug interactions for dermatological drugs from DDInter 2.0 database.
datasets.ddinter_hormonal.csv: Drug-drug interactions for systemic hormonal preparations from DDInter 2.0 database.
datasets.ddinter_respiratory.csv: Drug-drug interactions for respiratory system drugs from DDInter 2.0 database.
datasets.ddinter_various.csv: Drug-drug interactions for various drugs from DDInter 2.0 database.
datasets.enamine_cloud_library_smiles.pkl: Compounds from Enamine REAL library with SMILES annotations.
datasets.evebio_assay_table.csv: Assay metadata with one row per assay from EveBio pharmome mapping.
datasets.evebio_bundle_table.csv: Target subfamily bundles used for screening-to-profiling progression.
datasets.evebio_compound_table.csv: Compound metadata with common identifiers from EveBio screening.
datasets.evebio_control_table.csv: Control datapoints for all screening and profiling plates.
datasets.evebio_detailed_result_table.csv: Expanded results on evebio_summary_result_table with curve fit parameters and phase categories.
datasets.evebio_observed_points_table.csv: Raw observed datapoints from all screening and profiling experiments.
datasets.evebio_summary_result_table.csv: Succinct summary of results for each assay-compound combination.
datasets.evebio_target_table.csv: Target metadata with common identifiers from EveBio screening.
datasets.go-plus.json: Gene ontology data for functional gene annotations.
datasets.gtex_tissue_gene_tpm.parquet: Gene expression (TPM) across human tissues from GTEx.
datasets.hp.obo: Official HPO release in obographs format
datasets.kg.csv: Precision medicine knowledge graph with 17,080 diseases and 4+ million relationships across biological scales.
datasets.marker_celltype.parquet: Cell type marker genes for identification.
datasets.miRTarBase_MicroRNA_Target_Sites.parquet: Binding sites of microRNAs on target genes from miRTarBase.
datasets.miRTarBase_microRNA_target_interaction.p: Experimentally validated microRNA-target interactions from miRTarBase.
datasets.miRTarBase_microRNA_target_interaction_p: PubMed abstracts for microRNA-target interactions in miRTarBase.
datasets.mousemine_m3_regulatory_target_geneset.p: Regulatory target gene sets from MouseMine.
Cell type signature gene sets from MouseMine.
datasets.msigdb_human_c1_positional_geneset.parqu: Human positional gene sets from MSigDB.
datasets.msigdb_human_c2_curated_geneset.parquet: Curated human gene sets from MSigDB.
datasets.msigdb_human_c3_regulatory_target_genese: Regulatory target gene sets from MSigDB.
datasets.msigdb_human_c4_computational_geneset.pa: Computationally derived gene sets from MSigDB.
datasets.omim.parquet: Genetic disorders and associated genes from OMIM.
datasets.proteinatlas.tsv: Protein expression data from Human Protein Atlas.
datasets.proximity_label-ms.parquet: Protein interactions via proximity labeling and mass spectrometry.
datasets.synthetic_growth_defect.parquet: Synthetic growth defects from genetic interactions.
datasets.two-hybrid.parquet: Protein-protein interactions detected by yeast two-hybrid assays.

libraries.ADFR: AutoDock for Receptors suite for molecular docking and virtual screening.
libraries.anndata: [Python Package] A Python package for handling annotated data matrices in memory and on disk, primarily used for single-cell genomics data.
libraries.arboreto: A Python package for inferring gene regulatory networks from single-cell RNA-seq data.
libraries.arxiv: [Python Package] A Python wrapper for the arXiv API, allowing access to scientific papers.
libraries.autosite: [CLI Tool] A binding site detection tool used to identify potential ligand binding pockets on protein structures for molecular docking.
libraries.bedtools: [CLI Tool] A powerful toolset for genome arithmetic, allowing operations like intersect, merge, count, and complement on genomic features. Use with subprocess.run(['bedtools', ...]).
libraries.biom-format: [Python Package] The Biological Observation Matrix (BIOM) format is designed for representing biological sample by observation contingency tables with associated metadata.
libraries.biopandas: [Python Package] A package that provides pandas DataFrames for working with molecular structures and biological data.
libraries.biopython: [Python Package] A set of tools for biological computation including parsers for bioinformatics files, access to online services, and interfaces to common bioinformatics programs.
libraries.biotite: [Python Package] A comprehensive library for computational molecular biology, providing tools for sequence analysis, structure analysis, and more.
libraries.bowtie2: [CLI Tool] An ultrafast and memory-efficient tool for aligning sequencing reads to long reference sequences. Use with subprocess.run(['bowtie2', ...]).
libraries.bwa: [CLI Tool] Burrows-Wheeler Aligner for mapping low-divergent sequences against a large reference genome. Use with subprocess.run(['bwa', ...]).
libraries.cellpose: [Python Package] Cell segmentation in microscopy images.
libraries.cellxgene-census: [Python Package] A tool for accessing and analyzing the CellxGene Census, a collection of single-cell datasets. To download a dataset, use the download_source_h5ad function with the dataset id as the argument (856c1b98-5727-49da-bf0f-151bdb8cb056, no .h5ad extension).
libraries.clusterProfiler: [R Package] A package for statistical analysis and visualization of functional profiles for genes and gene clusters. Use with subprocess calls.
libraries.cobra: [Python Package] Constraint-based modeling of metabolic networks.
libraries.cooler: [Python Package] Storage and analysis of Hi-C data.
libraries.cryosparc-tools: [Python Package] Tools for working with cryoSPARC, a platform for cryo-EM data processing.
libraries.cyvcf2: [Python Package] Fast parsing of VCF files.
libraries.deeppurpose: [Python Package] A deep learning library for drug-target interaction prediction and virtual screening.
libraries.descriptastorus: [Python Package] A library for computing molecular descriptors for machine learning applications in drug discovery.
libraries.DESeq2: [R Package] Differential gene expression analysis based on the negative binomial distribution. Use with subprocess.run(['Rscript', '-e', 'library(DESeq2); ...']).
libraries.diamond: A sequence aligner for protein and translated DNA searches, designed for high performance analysis of big sequence data.
libraries.dplyr: [R Package] A grammar of data manipulation, providing a consistent set of verbs that help you solve the most common data manipulation challenges. Use with subprocess.
libraries.edgeR: [R Package] Empirical Analysis of Digital Gene Expression Data in R, for differential expression analysis. Use with subprocess calls.
libraries.faiss-cpu: [Python Package] A library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors.
libraries.fanc: [Python Package] Analysis of chromatin conformation data.
libraries.fastqc: [CLI Tool] A quality control tool for high throughput sequence data. Use with subprocess.run(['fastqc', ...]).
libraries.FastTree: [CLI Tool] Phylogenetic trees from sequence alignments.
libraries.fcsparser: A command-line tool for parsing and analyzing flow cytometry standard (FCS) files.
libraries.FlowIO: A Python package for reading and writing flow cytometry data files.
libraries.flowkit: [Python Package] Toolkit for processing flow cytometry data.
libraries.FlowUtils: Utilities for processing and analyzing flow cytometry data.
libraries.gcta64: [CLI Tool] Genome-wide Complex Trait Analysis (GCTA) tool for estimating the proportion of phenotypic variance explained by genome-wide SNPs and analyzing genetic relationships. Use with subprocess.run(['gcta64', ...]).
libraries.gget: [Python Package] A toolkit for accessing genomic databases and retrieving sequences, annotations, and other genomic data.
libraries.ggplot2: [R Package] A system for declaratively creating graphics, based on The Grammar of Graphics. Use with subprocess.run(['Rscript', '-e', 'library(ggplot2); ...']).
libraries.googlesearch-python: [Python Package] A library for performing Google searches programmatically.
libraries.gseapy: [Python Package] A Python wrapper for Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) and visualization.
libraries.h5py: [Python Package] A Python interface to the HDF5 binary data format, allowing storage of large amounts of numerical data.
libraries.harmony: [R Package] A method for integrating and analyzing single-cell data across datasets. Use with subprocess calls.
libraries.harmony-pytorch: [Python Package] A PyTorch implementation of the Harmony algorithm for integrating single-cell data.
libraries.Homer: [CLI Tool] Motif discovery and next-gen sequencing analysis.
libraries.hyperopt: [Python Package] A Python library for optimizing hyperparameters of machine learning algorithms.
libraries.iqtree2: [CLI Tool] An efficient phylogenetic software for maximum likelihood analysis with built-in model selection and ultrafast bootstrap. Use with subprocess.run(['iqtree2', ...]).
libraries.joblib: [Python Package] A set of tools to provide lightweight pipelining in Python, including transparent disk-caching and parallel computing.
libraries.lazyslide: [Python Package] A Python framework that brings interoperable, reproducible whole slide image analysis, enabling seamless histopathology workflows from preprocessing to deep learning.
libraries.lifelines: [Python Package] A complete survival analysis library for fitting models, plotting, and statistical tests.
libraries.limma: [R Package] Linear Models for Microarray Data, for differential expression analysis. Use with subprocess calls.
libraries.loompy: A Python implementation of the Loom file format for efficiently storing and working with large omics datasets.
libraries.macs2: [CLI Tool] Model-based Analysis of ChIP-Seq data, a tool for identifying transcript factor binding sites.
libraries.mafft: [CLI Tool] A multiple sequence alignment program for unix-like operating systems. Use with subprocess.run(['mafft', ...]).
libraries.mageck: [Python Package] Analysis of CRISPR screen data.
libraries.matplotlib: [Python Package] A comprehensive library for creating static, animated, and interactive visualizations in Python.
libraries.Matrix: [R Package] A package that provides classes and methods for dense and sparse matrices. Required for Seurat. Use with subprocess calls.
libraries.mudata: [Python Package] A Python package for multimodal data storage and manipulation, extending AnnData to handle multiple modalities.
libraries.nnunet: [Python Package] A deep learning framework for biomedical image segmentation, providing a standardized approach to training and inference.
libraries.numpy: [Python Package] The fundamental package for scientific computing with Python, providing support for arrays, matrices, and mathematical functions.
libraries.openbabel: [Python Package] A chemical toolbox designed to speak the many languages of chemical data, supporting file format conversion and molecular modeling.
libraries.opencv-python: [Python Package] OpenCV library for computer vision tasks, useful for image analysis in biological contexts.
libraries.openmm: [Python Package] A toolkit for molecular simulation using high-performance GPU computing.
libraries.optlang: A Python package for modeling optimization problems symbolically.
libraries.pandas: [Python Package] A fast, powerful, and flexible data analysis and manipulation library for Python.
libraries.pdbfixer: A Python package for fixing problems in PDB files in preparation for molecular simulations.
libraries.plannotate: [CLI Tool] A tool for annotating plasmid sequences with common features.
libraries.plink: [CLI Tool] A comprehensive toolkit for genome association studies that can perform a range of large-scale analyses in a computationally efficient manner. Use with subprocess.run(['plink', ...]).
libraries.plink2: [CLI Tool] A comprehensive toolkit for genome association studies that can perform a range of large-scale analyses in a computationally efficient manner. Use with subprocess.run(['plink2', ...]).
libraries.pybedtools: [Python Package] A Python wrapper for Aaron Quinlan's BEDTools programs.
libraries.pyBigWig: A Python library for accessing bigWig and bigBed files for genome browser track data.
libraries.pyfaidx: [Python Package] A Python package for efficient random access to FASTA files.
libraries.pykalman: [Python Package] Kalman filter and smoother implementation.
libraries.PyLabRobot: [Python Package] A Python package for controlling liquid-handling robots and other lab automation equipment.
libraries.pyliftover: [Python Package] A Python implementation of UCSC liftOver tool for converting genomic coordinates between genome assemblies.
libraries.pymc3: [Python Package] A Python package for Bayesian statistical modeling and probabilistic machine learning.
libraries.pymed: [Python Package] A Python library for accessing PubMed articles.
libraries.pymzml: A Python module for high-throughput bioinformatics analysis of mass spectrometry data.

libraries.pyranges: [Python Package] A Python package for interval manipulation with a pandas-like interface.
libraries.pysam: [Python Package] A Python module for reading, manipulating and writing genomic data sets in SAM/BAM/VCF/BCF formats.
libraries.pyscenic: [Python Package] Analysis of single-cell RNA-seq data and gene regulatory networks.
libraries.pyscreener: [Python Package] A Python package for virtual screening of chemical compounds.

libraries.rdkit: [Python Package] A collection of cheminformatics and machine learning tools for working with chemical structures and drug discovery.

libraries.samtools: [CLI Tool] A suite of programs for interacting with high-throughput sequencing data. Use with subprocess.run(['samtools', ...]).

libraries.scholarly: [Python Package] A module to retrieve author and publication information from Google Scholar.
libraries.scikit-bio: [Python Package] Data structures, algorithms, and educational resources for bioinformatics, including sequence analysis, phylogenetics, and ordination methods.
libraries.scikit-image: [Python Package] A collection of algorithms for image processing in Python.
libraries.scikit-learn: [Python Package] A machine learning library featuring various classification, regression, and clustering algorithms.
libraries.scipy: [Python Package] A Python library for scientific and technical computing, including modules for optimization, linear algebra, integration, and statistics.

libraries.scvelo: [Python Package] A tool for RNA velocity analysis in single cells using dynamical models.

libraries.statsmodels: [Python Package] A Python module for statistical modeling and econometrics, including descriptive statistics and estimation of statistical models.
libraries.stringr: [R Package] A cohesive set of functions designed to make working with strings as easy as possible. Use with subprocess calls.

libraries.trackpy: [Python Package] Particle tracking in images and video.

libraries.tskit: [Python Package] Handling tree sequences and population genetics data.
